# GMCC Procurement & Daily Food Flash System
**Golo Mori Convention Center (GMCC) - ITDC Kawasan Pariwisata Labuan Bajo**

Sistem ERP Procurement & Daily Food Flash terpadu untuk Golo Mori Convention Center, dibangun menggunakan **React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Express (Full-Stack)** serta dilengkapi integrasi **Google Apps Script (GAS) 100%**.

---

## 🚀 Cara Menjalankan Proyek (Local Development)

### 1. Prasyarat
- **Node.js** v18 atau lebih tinggi
- **npm** atau **bun**

### 2. Instalasi Dependensi
Buka terminal pada folder proyek ini, lalu jalankan:
```bash
npm install
```

### 3. Menjalankan Server Pengembangan (Dev Server)
Jalankan perintah berikut:
```bash
npm run dev
```
Aplikasi akan aktif di: **`http://localhost:3000`**

### 4. Build untuk Produksi
```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

---

## 📂 Struktur Direktori Proyek

```
├── src/                          # Frontend React + TypeScript
│   ├── components/               # Komponen UI (Sidebar, Navbar, Modals, PIN Dialog)
│   ├── context/                  # AuthContext, ToastContext
│   ├── modules/                  # Modul Utama:
│   │   ├── MasterDataView.tsx    # Vendor Master, Item Master Multi-Dept, Dept & CC
│   │   ├── RequisitionCreateView # Buat PR dengan vendor usulan & alamat GMCC
│   │   ├── RequisitionsListView  # Daftar PR & status approval
│   │   ├── ApprovalCenterView    # Matriks Approval Sekuensial 5 Tahap
│   │   ├── PurchaseOrdersView    # PO Resmi dengan 4 Kolom TTD Digital
│   │   ├── GoodsReceivingView    # Penerimaan Barang (GRN)
│   │   ├── DailyFoodFlashView    # 5 KPI Food Flash, Nett Revenue, In-Place Edit
│   │   └── AdminView.tsx         # Chat Box Rubah PIN & Setting TTD Pejabat
│   ├── types/                    # Definisi Interface TypeScript
│   ├── api.ts                    # Client API Handler
│   ├── App.tsx                   # Root Application
│   └── main.tsx                  # Vite Entry Point
│
├── server/                       # Backend Express & Mock Database
│   ├── routes.ts                 # REST API Endpoint untuk PR, PO, Master Data, Food Flash
│   └── storage.ts                # JSON File Storage Persistence
│
├── data/                         # Database JSON lokal
│   ├── users.json
│   ├── departments.json
│   ├── items.json
│   ├── vendors.json
│   ├── purchase_requisitions.json
│   ├── purchase_orders.json
│   └── food_flash.json
│
├── gas/                          # Versi 100% Google Apps Script
│   ├── Code.gs                   # Backend Google Apps Script & Sheets
│   ├── Index.html                # Frontend Web App HTML Service
│   └── README.md                 # Panduan Deploy 5 Menit ke script.google.com
│
├── public/                       # Static Assets & Logo GMCC
├── server.ts                     # Full-Stack Server Entry Point
├── vite.config.ts                # Vite Configuration
├── tsconfig.json                 # TypeScript Configuration
└── package.json                  # Dependencies & NPM Scripts
```
